units.source_text: 驹子是她师傅儿子的未婚妻，叶子是他的新情人，而他又快要病故，于是岛村的脑海里又泛出“徒劳”这两个字来。

en.t: Komako was the fiancee of her teacher's son, Yoko was his new lover, and he was soon to die of illness; so the two words, "futile effort," rose again in Shimamura's mind.

units.source_text: 驹子恪守婚约也罢，甚至卖身让他疗养也罢，这一切不是徒劳又是什么呢？

en.t: Whether Komako faithfully kept the engagement, or even sold herself so that he could convalesce, what could all of it be but futile effort?
